newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil/gas rigs up five at 70 in week.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil/gas rigs up five at 70 in week.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs operating in offshore Northwest European (NWE) waters rose five to 70 in the week ending March 12, up from 65 the previous week, consultants Arthur Andersen said.
The number of active rigs in U.K. waters rose two to 36 while rigs in Norwegian waters were unchanged at 20. The Danish sector rose one to four rigs and the Dutch sector was up two at 10 rigs.
The report said that exploration levels to date in every country but Britain were higher than in the same period last year.
